newsitem.title: GERMANY: Global One wins Samsung network order.
newsitem.headline: Global One wins Samsung network order.

text.p: Global One, the international telecommunications venture, said on Wednesday it had won an order from Samsung to provide the South Korean industry group with a trans-European high-speed data communications network.
The network, based on frame-relay technology, will be the first step in building a global corporate backbone network for the company's worldwide communications needs.
Global One, owned by Deutsche Telekom, France Telecom and Sprint Corp of the United States, said the "multi-million dollar" contract was for three years.
The planned network would connect 34 Samsung sites in 17 countries in Europe, Russia and the Central Asian republics, connecting remote Samsung sites with the company's hub in Brentford, England.
Global One gave no financial details about the deal.
